content: PR71 extends the existing learned-text evidence document path to matched concepts and valid relationship endpoints when source_refs are supplied, including all-existing and replayed learning. Connections-only extraction is grounded without invented concepts or overwriting prior concept provenance. Empty invalid output creates no evidence document. Base learn already gated documents on created_ids and did not persist structured source_refs; this is incomplete coverage of PR71 new guarantee, not a previously working provenance regression or intentional exclusion. Existing stamped databases also skip graph UUID INSERT to allow reads during active SQLite writer transactions; missing stamps still use atomic INSERT OR IGNORE. Canonical serialization and canonical source rebinding remain separate runtime gaps. Current databases may hold the only complete copy of durable state and must be preserved during planned cleanup; deletion-independent recovery remains a design goal, not a shipped guarantee.
title: Relationship learning retains per-call durable evidence

verification.prov_method: Public MCP matrix: existing/mixed/connections-only x project/global/mixed sources; replay; no-op; reopen and source resolution; concurrent-writer read
